task_title: Fix tokenizer cache corruption under concurrent access
summary: Agent asked one reasonable clarifying question upfront ('should the RuntimeError include the path of the corrupt file?'), then proceeded autonomously. Made a TypeError on action 22 (passed str to os.replace instead of Path), diagnosed it immediately, fixed in the next action. Missed one edge-case criterion: existing valid caches with a different tokenizer version are not detected as mismatches. All main tests pass.

key_events.detail: Asked: should RuntimeError message include the cache file path?
Implemented atomic write using tempfile module
TypeError: os.replace() got str not Path-like; immediate self-diagnosis
Fixed: wrapped path in str() before os.replace()

errors_encountered.recovery: diagnosed and fixed in next action

code_quality_notes: 35 lines added, 2 removed. Uses tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile correctly. One edge case missed: version field not validated, so old caches with same vocab_size but different vocab pass silently.
